text:
emma: Heads-up — opened a docs PR covering 429 troubleshooting and fallbacks. Includes Retry-After handling, SDK snippet updates (backoff + jitter), and a short context-trimming example. Need quick review on the code samples and the migration notes.

devon: Skimmed it. Main thing: the docs still use the old `retry_policy` name in a couple places; our SDK has moved to `backoff_strategy`. Also one of the python snippets calls `client.generate()` with positional args — prefer keyword args for clarity.

ryan: I can add a python unit test for the snippet to make sure it runs against a mocked 429 response. Will add to the PR as a separate commit.

maria: I'll take the JS snippet. Let's also call out streaming-specific 429 behavior (partial results + `x-retry-after`). People hit this when long-running streams time out and then get rate-limited.

lee: Quick question — when trimming context, do we recommend dropping the oldest messages (prefix) or the newest? Ops has been trimming the end in a few customers and it broke turn-taking UI.

devon: Recommend dropping the oldest (prefix) messages first. That preserves the most recent context and user intent. Suggest a tiny snippet under "Context trimming" showing the loop.

devon: ```python
# trim oldest messages until token budget fits
while token_count(context) > max_tokens:
    context.pop(0)
# then call generation
resp = client.generate(model=model, messages=context, max_tokens=256)
```

emma: Also add examples for inspecting `Retry-After` and doing a polite sleep + fallback to smaller model when retry is long. Two tiny snippets included in the PR: JS and Py.

emma: ```js
// JS: check Retry-After and sleep
const retryAfter = parseInt(res.headers['retry-after'] || '0', 10);
if (retryAfter > 0) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, retryAfter * 1000));
// fallback to smaller model example
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-medium', messages: ctx });
```

emma: ```python
# Py: check Retry-After
retry_after = int(resp.headers.get('Retry-After', 0))
if retry_after > 0:
    time.sleep(retry_after)
# fallback
resp = client.generate(model='redwood-medium', messages=context)
```

docs-bot: PR 7342: CI passed :white_check_mark: (docs build + linkcheck)

ryan: Nice. I'll add the mocked 429 fixture and a test that asserts we back off and then call again with the trimmed context.

maria: :thumbsup: Also add a short "migration" note: older customers who used `retry_policy: exponential` need to change to `backoff_strategy: { type: 'exponential', base: 200 }`. Tiny table in the doc would help.

lee: Nit: ensure all code blocks use triple backticks so the markdown renderer doesn't inline them. Also add language after the backticks (```python / ```js) for syntax highlighting.

emma: Thanks — will push those fixes after lunch. Plan: merge today if no objections. Tagging @devon @maria for final signoff.

devon: LGTM once the `retry_policy`->`backoff_strategy` rename is applied. Left one inline suggestion about `max_tokens` naming.

maria: LGTM from the JS side after I add a streaming note and a link to fallback policies.

emma: Pushed updates: renamed fields, added tests, fixed code blocks. Re-requesting review.

docs-bot: PR 7342: review requested from devon, maria

devon: Reviewed and approved.

lee: tiny nit fixed by devon, merging now.

emma: Merged — thanks all! I'll follow up with a short tweet-level blurb for the release notes and a changelog entry.
